items.label: SHADOWFIRE{03}{03}{03}{03}{03}{03}
items.why: the boot program the KERNAL loads at $02A7-$030B, over BASIC's vectors: it unscrambles the turbo loader in the tape buffer and runs it

items.label: SHADOWFIRE{03}{03}{03}{03}{03}{03} (header)
items.why: the tape's header: after the name, the turbo loader that reads the ten blocks, stored scrambled

items.label: turbo block 1
items.why: BASIC's six vectors at their usual values, as the listing holds them at $0300

items.label: turbo block 2
items.why: the loading picture's screen colours, at $0C00; the Graphics tab draws the picture, and block 9 loads over them

items.label: turbo block 3
items.why: the loading picture's colour RAM; the Graphics tab draws the picture

items.label: turbo block 4
items.why: the loading picture's bitmap, at $2000-$3F3F, which the Graphics tab draws, with 3,072 bytes below it at $1400-$1FFF that the picture does not use and that nothing runs or shows before block 9 loads over them (TODO.md)

items.label: turbo block 5
items.why: the video chip's 48 registers, which put the loading picture on the screen

items.label: turbo block 8
items.why: the video chip's 48 registers again, which turn the picture off before block 9 loads over it

items.label: turbo block 9
items.why: every byte of it the listing holds is equal, 8,175 of them; the other 5,904 are the parts of the screen the game draws as it runs, which the listing leaves out
